capabilities.difference: The paired application corpus covers mixed UTF-8 text, Unicode/spaced paths, content-sniffed PNG, duplicate/empty files, BMP conversion, valid JPEG/GIF/WebP pass-through, 256 images without truncation, hints, image order, prompt composition, and relative, absolute, home-expanded and symlinked paths. A provider-visible differential confirms deferred selected-model normalization omits a truncated PNG and preserves a following valid image. Additional file-path malformed/cancellation cases and input-growth limits are covered by local regressions rather than this paired corpus.

PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP resizing and BMP encoded bytes are codec-equivalent by MIME, decoded dimensions and hints; encoded bytes are intentionally not compared. Supported-format pass-through is strict. Malformed/truncated JPEG, GIF and WebP payload cases match omission; one RIFF-size-mismatched WebP is accepted by Pi's Photon decoder but rejected by Skia, a documented stricter safety exclusion.

evidence: pinned packages/coding-agent/test/suite/agent-session-prompt.test.ts: uses the model selected by before_agent_start for image normalization
capabilities.difference: Physical virtual-model routing remains additionally projected at the provider boundary; complete parity for every virtual-route interleaving remains to be documented.

Focused local print, JSON, RPC and interactive coverage exists. Paired JSON-mode and RPC provider-visible prompt cases pass 2/2 with stable same-Pi calibration; print and interactive workflow evidence is focused local coverage rather than a paired full application journey.

The three supported provider image requests match pinned physical boundaries for ordered text/image parts and exact PNG bytes; blocked-image wire projection remains outside this focused report. Post-restart branched image continuation is separately verified by multimodal-session-provider-wire-differential-2026-10-25.json.

Empty clipboard and backend errors are distinguished; focused PiSharp clipboard tests pass, including file-path precedence, pinned clipboard/print/prompt selections pass 51/51, and the paired acquisition/path-precedence report passes 4/4 with stable same-Pi calibration. Fresh native macOS/Windows contract jobs remain to be verified on the final published head.
No new discrepancy recorded in the focused review.

PiSharp previously stored raw prompt image bytes while Pi stores normalized bytes; accepted-input normalization now occurs after before_agent_start selection and before canonical persistence. A pinned differential passes 3/3 strict comparisons for initial provider content, restored canonical image and continuation provider content after saved-session reopen. A separate physical-wire differential passes 3/3 protocols after branch selection and restart, retaining the selected image and excluding the inactive image. Broader branch behavior remains open.

Paired cases cover malformed/truncated image handling and 256 image attachments without truncation. Local tests cover 20 MiB file bounds, read-time growth rejection, pixel-count rejection before decode, cancellation before and after pixel decode, and clipboard-file cleanup on cancellation. Pinned Pi reads image resize limits in its processing path; maxPerMessage, maxPerRequest and maxRequestBytes appear as model metadata and have no enforcement path in the pinned runtime. The clipboard writer catches all write/flush failures and deletes the created path; ordinary disk-write failure is source-reviewed, while cancellation exercises that cleanup branch.
Native clipboard process verification is configured in dedicated macOS and Windows CI jobs; previous exact-head jobs passed. Fresh CI for this follow-up remains pending.
